errors.fix: Make sure the command you are trying to run exists in your $PATH
Check the command's help page for valid options
Make sure you have the necessary permissions to run the command
Make sure the file or directory exists and the path is correct

errors.message: Tried to treat a directory as a regular file
errors.fix: Point the command at a file inside the directory instead of the directory itself

errors.message: Hit the OS limit on open file descriptors
errors.fix: Raise the open-files limit (ulimit -n), or check for file/socket handles that aren't being closed
Free up disk space before retrying
Check file ownership/permissions, or that this isn't a protected system path (e.g. macOS SIP)

errors.message: The process was killed, likely by the OOM killer
errors.fix: Reduce memory usage, or increase the available memory/swap
